title: Todd Monken on Shedeur Sanders: It feels like he's making quicker decisions

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken on Shedeur Sanders: It feels like he's making quicker decisions
sources.description: With head coach Todd Monken saying the Browns’ quarterback competition will continue into training camp, second-year signal-caller Shedeur Sanders will have the chance to show what he can do with pads on.
